fluff.overview: Drawing veterans from the Com Guards, recruits from the Free Worlds League, and volunteers from Protectorate worlds, the Word of Blake Militia assembled infantry formations whose quality varied but whose equipment was consistently first-rate. Mechanized wheeled Level I formations used wheeled APCs for efficient patrol and garrison operations on developed worlds within the Protectorate. Their lower maintenance burden compared to tracked or hover transports made them the most common mechanized infantry type in the Word of Blake Militia's order of battle. Equipped with laser rifles that offer superior range and armor penetration compared to ballistic weapons, these troops field one of the most effective personal arms available to conventional infantry, though the weapons are significantly more expensive and require soldiers to carry additional power packs.
